items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: I went to work with Sig Meyers... I was with the band, too... I stayed with Sig four years and five months.

ctx.x: Oh, you tell me about it. You asked me some time ago about what happened when I left the Playhouse. Well, I worked the Playhouse. Well, I worked the Playhouse. And it was through the New Orleans Rhythm King at Friars Inn that I went to work with Sig Meyers. Uh, when Sig approached me about the thing, he didn't offer me much money, but he offered me a short job. And that was, uh, 8.30 till 12. It was five sessions a week. Uh, Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday night, Sunday night, and Sunday afternoon. Three hours on…
Was that a big band, huh?
